sampling.random_seed_note: not supported by current provider transport

uncertainty_note: Paired percentile bootstrap intervals use 10,000 case resamples and seed 15015. They describe sensitivity to this fixed 60-case sample, not model sampling variance or deployment-population generalization.
business_accuracy_note: All three versions have denominator 0 because no frozen case has an independent business-answer reference. Business accuracy is not independently evaluated.

ablation_interpretation.retrieval_context: The direct_sql versus retrieval_sql comparison is the real-model retrieval-context ablation, with extra context length and prompt layout recorded confounders.
ablation_interpretation.bounded_repair: No repair model call occurred in the full-agent main run. A new real-model repair-off run would be observationally identical for repair contribution and was not run.
ablation_interpretation.full_agent_bundle: Retrieval_sql versus full_agent changes planning, safety gating, state handling, execution, and deterministic calculation together; their individual causal effects cannot be separated by this comparison.

provider_console_intermediate_snapshot.note: Provider-console counters can refresh asynchronously and use actual cache-aware billing. This intermediate snapshot must not be substituted for the final local run ledger or described as the final experiment bill.

prior_invalid_run_note: The first direct-SQL development run consumed 60 calls but produced adapter_exception records because the temporary evaluation snapshot omitted the updated ModelResponse telemetry fields. One additional call diagnosed the mismatch. No prompt, gold, or scoring rule was changed; the invalid artifacts remain separate.

WITH delivered_orders AS (
  SELECT order_id, order_purchase_timestamp
  FROM fact_orders
  WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp >= :start_ts
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < :end_ts
),
items_agg AS (
  SELECT oi.order_id,
         SUM(oi.price) AS gmv,
         SUM(oi.freight_value) AS freight
  FROM fact_order_items oi
  JOIN delivered_orders d ON d.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.order_id
),
payments_agg AS (
  SELECT p.order_id,
         SUM(p.payment_value) AS payment_amount
  FROM fact_payments p
  JOIN delivered_orders d ON d.order_id = p.order_id
  GROUP BY p.order_id
)
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', d.order_purchase_timestamp) AS purchase_month,
       SUM(COALESCE(i.gmv, 0)) AS gmv,
       SUM(COALESCE(i.freight, 0)) AS freight,
       SUM(COALESCE(p.payment_amount, 0)) AS payment_amount,
       SUM(COALESCE(p.payment_amount, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(i.gmv, 0) + COALESCE(i.freight, 0)) AS reconciliation_difference
FROM delivered_orders d
LEFT JOIN items_agg i ON i.order_id = d.order_id
